audience: on-call engineers and incident responders who use Squadcast

useCases.title: List incidents triggered in a time window
useCases.text: The AI lists incidents for a team in a time window, filtered by status, service, priority or assignee, and sums them up.

useCases.title: Read the timeline and notes of an incident
useCases.text: The AI reads the events of an incident (state changes, notifications, actions) and its war-room notes, and writes a short summary.

useCases.title: Check on-call schedules and escalation
useCases.text: The AI lists on-call schedules for a team, including the ones where you are on call now, and the team's escalation policies.

useCases.title: Acknowledge or resolve an incident
useCases.text: The AI acknowledges a triggered incident, which stops paging, or resolves it with a resolution message.

useCases.title: Add a note to an incident
useCases.text: The AI adds a war-room note to a live incident, for example a status update, optionally with attachment URLs.

useCases.title: Review services, squads, teams and users
useCases.text: The AI lists services and squads of a team, the teams, and the users in the organization.
